title: world.shapes.get
description: The client asks for a region's shape documents it doesn't hold (after a world.shapes.offer), each by the content hash the offer named. The server answers with that document's world.shapes parts while it still publishes it, else with nothing (a rebuild sends a new offer).

index.description: The shape index wanted: the offer's index hash.

map.description: The shape map wanted: the offer's map hash.

region.description: MG3 (several games): the region this message belongs to; absent = the legacy region. The client tags what it relays with its link's region; the server routes a tagged message to that region's link.
